target: 310P3 synchronized captured operator wall time; 3 samples, 30 replays per sample
selection: non-negative least squares, additive instruction/data-movement work proxy; fixed intercept excluded from candidate ranking
units: Loads and DMA use half-element counts, Cube uses multiply-accumulate counts, epilogue uses output element counts. Feature counts are on the busiest spatial/channel core group. This is a ranking proxy, not an assertion of physical pipeline latency.
bitwise: All retained candidates compared raw FP16 bits to the 32/16 default on the same random input and weights before timing; mismatches were not timed. The successful sweep logged no mismatches.
environment: Ascend 310P3, CANN 9.0.0 in one calibration container environment; defaults are not hardware-independent constants. Recalibrate after hardware, driver or runtime environment changes.
use: Documentation of fitted default ranking weights only; runtime planning enumerates legal capacity-constrained candidates and does not read measurement data or select from a shape lookup table.
